images.filename: Tin Mine in the Northern Territory.jpg
images.caption: The tin mine at Maranboy. Harold Snell and two partners had a tin mining lease here. He was working there when he enlisted. His two partners continued to work the mine during the war when prices were good and banked his share of the profits. Just before Harold returned to the Territory, a solicitor and the profits disappeared to Singapore. (PH0233/0048)
